# Ridgeline Automation

> AI workflow automation agency based in Roanoke, Virginia. We build and maintain custom automations that eliminate manual work for local businesses — invoicing, scheduling, data entry, lead follow-up, report generation, and more. We serve the Roanoke Valley and New River Valley region. Founded by DeShea Witcher.

## What We Do

Ridgeline Automation specializes in AI-powered workflow automation for small and mid-size businesses in Southwest Virginia. We identify manual, repetitive tasks in a business's operations and replace them with automated systems that run reliably — and that we maintain on an ongoing retainer basis.

We are a local agency, not an offshore service. Every client works directly with DeShea Witcher, the founder. We take in-person meetings throughout the Roanoke Valley and New River Valley.

## Founder

DeShea Witcher is the founder of Ridgeline Automation. He has lived in Roanoke, Virginia for 15 years and has 15+ years of experience building growth and automation systems for companies ranging from regional businesses to global enterprise brands. He has earned Cybersecurity Marketer of the Year and Marketing Executive of the Year awards, and has built $42M+ in marketing pipeline through AI-driven systems. DeShea holds a B.S. in Marketing from Ferrum College and certifications including CDMP, Google Ads, HubSpot, Demandbase ABM, Pragmatic PMC, and MIT Sloan AI in Business programs.

## How It Works

The engagement follows three steps:

1. Free Discovery Call — 30-minute phone or video call. Free, no obligation. We assess whether automation is the right move and explain what the paid audit involves.
2. Workflow Discovery Audit — $750 flat fee (credited to any build). 90-minute on-site session mapping workflows, identifying automation opportunities, and delivering a written roadmap with ROI estimates within 48 hours.
3. Custom Automation Build — $3,000–$12,000 flat fee, scoped after audit. Average 11-day delivery. Full IP ownership transfers to client on handoff.
4. Maintenance Retainer — $400–$1,200/month. Monthly monitoring, tuning, repair, and status reporting.

## Services

- Free Discovery Call — Free, 30 minutes, no obligation. Entry point to all engagements.
- Workflow Discovery Audit — $750 flat fee, credited to build. On-site workflow mapping and written ROI roadmap.
- Custom Automation Build — $3,000–$12,000 flat fee. Scoped after audit. Average 11-day delivery. Full documentation and IP transfer.
- Maintenance Retainer — $400–$1,200/month. Three tiers: Basic ($400, up to 3 automations), Standard ($750, up to 6 automations), Growth ($1,200, unlimited).

## Service Area

Primary: Roanoke, VA
Also serving: Salem VA, Blacksburg VA, Christiansburg VA, Vinton VA, Lynchburg VA, and surrounding New River Valley communities.

## Industries Served

- Healthcare (medical practices, Carilion/Centra network affiliates, dental, behavioral health)
- Manufacturing and industrial operations (Salem corridor, production reporting, QC workflows)
- Professional services (legal, accounting, consulting, financial advisory)
- Technology startups and VT spinoffs (Blacksburg corridor)
- Distribution and logistics
- Trade contractors (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping)
- Nonprofits and education-adjacent organizations
- Retail and local commerce

## Common Automations

- Invoice processing and accounts receivable
- Appointment scheduling and no-show reduction
- Customer and patient follow-up sequences
- Lead qualification and routing
- Data entry elimination across disconnected systems
- Automated report generation and KPI pipelines
- Staff onboarding workflows
- Estimate follow-up sequences
- Payment reminders and collections
- Review request automation
- Vendor communication and PO workflows
- Contract routing and document processing
- Job dispatch and field service scheduling
- Payroll preparation workflows
- Client and patient intake automation
- Inventory reorder alerts

## Tools and Platforms

Make (Integromat), n8n, Zapier, REST APIs, OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Salesforce, Airtable, Notion, Google Workspace, Slack, Twilio, Stripe, Calendly, Acuity, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, Kareo, Xero, FreshBooks, Postgres/MySQL, webhooks.
